Subject: Proposed speaker on-call rotation + calendar lock for Nov webinars

Team —

We're entering a busy two-week webinar window (customer panels + product demo series). To avoid last-minute scramble, I'm proposing a lightweight speaker "on-call" rota so each SME owns a 24‑hour standby window for quick follow-ups, demo handoffs, and last-minute guest coaching. Details:

- Primary on-call window: 9am PST — 9am PST next day (24h)
- Primary responsibilities: be reachable for production questions, own demo handoff, cover live Q&A if moderator needs escalation
- Backup: assigned peer if primary is unavailable

I've attached a draft speaker_oncall_grid.csv and run_of_show_v3.xlsx (very compact) with suggested slots for Nov 9–20. Please:
1) Reply with any hard blackout dates by EOD Monday (Nov 2).
2) Confirm which slot you can take (I'll lock calendars once we have confirmations).
3) If you're happy to be backup for someone specific, call it out.

Also looped: we're confirming Acme Finance's guest speaker (Jordan Smith) for Nov 12 10:00am PT. I'll reach out to Jordan once we lock internal coverage.

Thanks —
Naomi
